description: Files under apps/*/lib and lib/pages that keep the rules of the legacy path in from until their redraw: the Catch lints evaluate a carried file as that path, so its reasoned ignores and drawing stay legal. Only tool/architecture/move_screens.mjs adds entries, for moved files whose old path was not under a new root; the two screens that predate D24 carry their own path. catch_arch_stale_carry reports an entry whose file already meets the new-root rules, and the entry then goes. Keep entries sorted by path, one per line with a blank line between them, so parallel moves merge cleanly. See docs/app_architecture.md, Carried screens.
